remarks: Welcome to 17191 Corbina Lane, Unit 105, located in the desirable gated Cabo Del Mar community of Huntington Beach! This inviting condo features recently replaced luxury vinyl flooring, providing a fresh, modern feel. Residents enjoy resort-style amenities including a swimming pool, spa, sauna, tennis courts, racquetball court, clubhouse, and beautifully maintained grounds. Ideally situated near Huntington Harbour, Bolsa Chica Wetlands, scenic walking and biking trails, and just minutes from the beach. Conveniently close to shopping, restaurants, and everyday essentials. Enjoy comfortable coastal living in a fantastic Huntington Beach location!
